title: US-short §13 lifecycle calibration register — the dynamic per-item live-forward accumulator that us_short_lifecycle_eval scans (before the weekly render) to decide which §13.1 calibration items are due
description: Batch-3 PRIVATE state contract (design §13 / §13.1 / §13.2 / §18.1 #20). The register is the per-§13.1-item live-forward accumulator: it carries ONLY the accumulated live_forward_count + the §12.2② upgrade_margin_frozen flag + the derived `due` state (+ number/title). It deliberately does NOT carry threshold metadata — the threshold is GOVERNED: engine/us_short_lifecycle_eval.py DERIVES each item's count_type / min_count / secondary_required from us_short_lifecycle_threshold_authority by number, so the mutable private register CANNOT self-author / lower its own review threshold (R-USSHORT-BATCH3-R2-LIFECYCLE-THRESHOLD-SELF-AUTHORING-BYPASS) — additionalProperties:false here rejects a register that tries to smuggle threshold_min_count / count_type / threshold_category back in. It contains per-item counts and (later) ticker/performance detail, so it MUST live only on a gitignored private path (state/us_short/lifecycle/, §11.6); tracked surfaces carry only de-identified summaries. This schema pins STRUCTURE only. draft-07 cannot express: coverage (every §13.1 item enrolled, no missing/extra/duplicate — the §13 coverage insurance), the `number`/`title` cross-ref to us_short_lifecycle_calibration_governance, and the GOVERNED `due == (live_forward_count >= governed_min_count AND (secondary_condition_met OR NOT governed_secondary_required))` invariant — all enforced by engine/us_short_lifecycle_eval.py against the threshold authority + tests.

item.description: One §13.1 calibration item's live-forward accumulator (live_forward_count + upgrade_margin_frozen + derived due). additionalProperties false — it carries NO threshold metadata (the threshold is governed by us_short_lifecycle_threshold_authority, derived by number); the number/title cross-ref + the governed `due` invariant are enforced by the lifecycle_eval validator, not here.
